t: A self-governing British dominion formed on 31 May 1910 from the Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies.
Its gold mines, migrant labour system and land laws built Africa’s strongest economy on racial segregation.
It fought in both world wars, gained full sovereignty in 1931 and became the apartheid republic in 1961.
dyk: The Union had three capitals: Pretoria for the government, Cape Town for parliament and Bloemfontein for the Appellate Division, a compromise South Africa still keeps.
ev: The Union of South Africa is proclaimed, with Louis Botha as prime minister
The South African Native National Congress, later the ANC, is founded at Bloemfontein
The Natives Land Act restricts African land ownership to reserves
South African forces conquer German South West Africa
The Statute of Westminster confirms the Union’s legislative independence
D. F. Malan’s National Party wins power and begins apartheid
Police kill 69 protesters at Sharpeville; white voters approve a republic
The Union becomes the Republic of South Africa on 31 May

f.predecessor: Cape Colony, Natal Colony, Transvaal Colony and Orange River Colony
